title: Why we built yet another Postgres connection pooler
summary: PgDog is a high-performance PostgreSQL connection pooler built in Rust, designed to address scalability and performance limitations in existing solutions like PgBouncer and Pgpool-II. The article explains why the authors created yet another connection pooler despite market saturation, focusing on modern async architecture and better resource utilization.
problem_solved: PostgreSQL connection exhaustion caused by the one-process-per-connection model limiting scalability for high-concurrency applications
why_valuable: Provides a modern Rust-based alternative with better async performance, memory efficiency, and feature completeness compared to existing poolers
